arguments.sql: SELECT s.name AS substance, t.hh_hazard_adi_lower_value AS adi, t.hh_hazard_adi_uom AS adi_unit, t.hh_hazard_adi_critical_endpoint AS adi_basis, t.hh_hazard_arfd_lower_value AS arfd, t.hh_hazard_arfd_uom AS arfd_unit, t.hh_hazard_arfd_critical_endpoint AS arfd_basis, t.hh_hazard_aoel_value AS aoel, t.hh_hazard_aoel_uom AS aoel_unit FROM efsa_openfoodtox__tox_ref_values AS t INNER JOIN (SELECT document_uuid, name FROM efsa_openfoodtox__substances WHERE lower(name) IN ('carbaryl','carbofuran','methomyl','aldicarb','oxamyl','propoxur','methiocarb')) AS s ON t.document_uuid = s.document_uuid WHERE t.hh_hazard_adi_lower_value IS NOT NULL OR t.hh_hazard_arfd_lower_value IS NOT NULL LIMIT 30
